post.description: Hashes the password (bcrypt cost 12) and optionally assigns role slugs in the same transaction. Cannot create a user in another school — `school_id` is taken from the caller.

get.description: Paginated and school-scoped. Soft-deleted users are excluded. Filters: `search` (substring on name/email), `role` (slug), `status`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match against name or email.

get.description: Cross-school requests return 404, never 403, so user IDs are not enumerable across tenants.
get.summary: Get one user by id (principal, vice_principal)

patch.description: Cannot change email, school_id, or roles. Switching status to `inactive`/`suspended` bumps the user's `tokenVersion` and revokes every active refresh token (BR-USR-07).

delete.description: Sets `deleted_at`, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token. The principal cannot delete their own account.

post.description: Idempotent — assigning a role the user already holds is a no-op. The actor is recorded in user_roles.assigned_by.
post.summary: Assign a role to a user (principal only)

404.description: User or role mapping not found

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user (principal only)

post.description: Hashes the supplied password with bcrypt cost 12, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token for the target user (`admin_action`).
post.summary: Reset another user's password (principal only) — BR-USR-05

get.description: Returns the seeded role catalog. Used by the user-management UI to populate role pickers and by anywhere that needs to map between numeric ids and slugs.

post.description: On success, returns an access token and the user view, and sets the `refresh_token` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=`/auth`). All failure paths — bad password, unknown email, inactive account, rate-limited, lockout — return the same `401 Invalid credentials` shape.
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` cookie. Replaying a rotated/revoked token revokes the entire token family and returns 401 (BR-AUTH-07).

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked refresh cookie

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and mint a new access token

post.description: Idempotent — clears the cookie either way and never reveals whether the token was valid.
Kills every device session for the authenticated user. Existing access tokens still work until they expire (15 min); see BR-USR-07 for cut-on-next-request via `tokenVersion`.
post.summary: Revoke every refresh token for the caller

post.description: Always returns 200 with the same message regardless of whether the email exists — never reveals membership. The reset token is one-time, valid for 1 hour.

get.description: Read-only — does not consume the token, bump tokenVersion, or revoke anything. Used by the reset-password page to render the email and gate the form.
get.summary: Check whether a reset token is currently usable

get.description: Authorization is role-based — the response carries a flat `roles` slug array and intentionally no `permissions` field.

post.description: `password` and `password_confirmation` must match (validated before any DB work). On success: bumps `tokenVersion`, revokes every active refresh token (`password_change`), and marks the reset token used.
post.summary: Consume a reset token and set a new password

post.description: Verifies the current password before applying. Revokes every other refresh token for the user (`password_change`); the caller's current refresh cookie keeps working so the active session is preserved. Mounted under `/auth` so the cookie (Path=`/api/auth`) is in scope.

get.description: Returns one entry per active refresh token. The entry for the device that owns the current cookie is flagged with `current: true`.
get.summary: List active sessions for the caller

delete.description: Revokes the refresh token row identified by `id` if and only if it belongs to the caller. Cross-user requests return 404, never 403, so token IDs are not enumerable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Refresh token row id (BIGINT as string)

404.description: Session not found or not owned by caller

patch.description: Whitelist enforced via DTO + global `forbidNonWhitelisted` — sending `email`, `school_id`, `status`, or `roles` returns 400 (BR-USR-06).

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of students visible to the caller. Scope rules per role:
- **principal / vice_principal**: all active students in the school.
- **supervisor**: students in halaqat the supervisor oversees.
- **teacher**: students in halaqat where the teacher is primary.
- **parent**: their own children across all schools (the one exception to strict school-scoping).

`include_deleted=true` is silently ignored for non-principal/VP callers. Does NOT write an audit log (read-only).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Omit to return all statuses.

parameters.name: halaqa_id
parameters.description: Filter by halaqa. For supervisors/teachers this is an additional scope filter on top of their role-based visibility.

parameters.name: id_number
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on national ID number (normalized before comparison).

post.description: Creates a student in the caller's school. An optional `guardians[]` array links guardians atomically in the same transaction — the first entry is forced to `is_primary=true` regardless of the submitted value. For the email-branch guardian flow, if no user exists a new account is created with the `parent` role and a parent-invite email is dispatched. Audit: `student.create` (+ `student.guardian.link` per linked guardian).

get.description: Returns the full student record including all linked guardians. Out-of-scope or cross-school access returns **404** (not 403) to avoid leaking student existence. Guardians are loaded eagerly and sorted by creation time (primary first is not guaranteed — check `is_primary`). Does NOT write an audit log.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

get.summary: Get a student by ID (with guardians)

patch.description:
Updates an in-scope student. Caller role determines allowed fields:
- **principal / vice_principal**: all fields in `UpdateStudentDto` (bio + capacity + notes).
- **teacher**: capacity fields + `notes` only (`UpdateStudentByTeacherDto`). Teacher must be the **primary teacher** on at least one of the student's halaqat; otherwise 403. Submitting bio fields as a teacher returns 400.

Capacity values out of range (hifz 0–20, near 0–50, far 0–100) return 400. Audit: `student.update` with `oldValues`/`newValues` of changed fields only.

400.description: Validation failure or capacity out of range

403.description: Teacher not primary on any of the student's halaqat

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

delete.description: Soft-deletes the student (sets `deleted_at`). The student no longer appears in list results unless `include_deleted=true` is passed. Guardian links are preserved and can be restored. Audit: `student.delete`.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

post.description: Clears `deleted_at` and returns the student to active status. Only applies to soft-deleted students; calling on a non-deleted student is a no-op. Audit: `student.restore`.

Sets `status = graduated`. Does **not** soft-delete the student — the record is retained for historical reporting. Graduating an already-graduated student returns 400. `graduation_date` and `notes` are stored in the audit log `newValues` only, not on the student record. Audit: `student.graduate`.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

get.description: Returns all guardians linked to the student, sorted by creation time (ascending). Caller must pass the `StudentScopeGuard` — out-of-scope or cross-school access returns 404. Does NOT write an audit log.

404.description: Student not found or out of scope

post.description:
Links a guardian to the student via one of two flows:

**ID flow** (`guardian_user_id`): the user must exist in the same school. `ensureRoleBySlug("parent", ...)` is called — idempotent, adds role if missing. Returns 404 if the user does not exist in this school.

**Email flow** (`email`): if a user with that email exists, they are linked (same as ID flow). If not, a new user is created with a random temporary password and the `parent` role, and a parent-invite email is dispatched containing a set-password link (7-day TTL).

**`is_primary` invariant (seven cases):**
1. First guardian on the student → forced to `is_primary=true`.
2. Subsequent guardian with `is_primary=true` → unsets the existing primary first.
3. Subsequent guardian with `is_primary=false` (or omitted) → leaves existing primary alone.

Audit: `student.guardian.link`.

400.description: Validation failure or guardian already linked

404.description: Student or guardian user not found in this school

post.summary: Link a guardian to a student (BR-STU-05)

patch.description:
Updates `relation`, `is_primary`, or `can_pickup` for an existing guardian link.

**`is_primary` rules:**
- `is_primary=true`: unsets the current primary, then sets this guardian as primary. Audit: `student.guardian.update` + implicit `student.guardian.primary_promoted` for the old primary.
- `is_primary=false`: always rejected with **400** — demoting a primary is not permitted directly. Instead, promote a different guardian.

Audit: `student.guardian.update`.

404.description: Student or guardian link not found

delete.description:
Removes the guardian link. Behaviour depends on whether the guardian is the primary:

- **Non-primary**: unlinked without side effects.
- **Primary, others remain**: earliest-created remaining guardian is auto-promoted to primary. Audit: `student.guardian.primary_promoted`.
- **Last guardian**: link removed. Audit: `student.orphaned`. A notification is dispatched to all vice_principals in the school via `NotificationService` (currently a logger stub — real delivery TBD).

Audit: `student.guardian.unlink`.

404.description: Student or guardian link not found

delete.summary: Unlink a guardian from a student (BR-STU-07)

get.description: Returns all students for which the authenticated parent has a `student_guardians` entry. **Cross-school exception**: this is the only endpoint in the system that returns students from multiple schools. A parent's children may be enrolled at different schools, so the school-scope rule is intentionally bypassed here. Soft-deleted students are excluded. No pagination — returns all children in one response. Does NOT write an audit log.

403.description: Caller does not have the parent role

get.description: Returns the full student record including all guardians. Returns **404** if the student does not exist or the caller is not linked to the student as a guardian — never 403, to avoid leaking student existence. **Cross-school exception**: parent may access a child in a different school than their own. Does NOT write an audit log.

403.description: Caller does not have the parent role

404.description: Student not found or caller is not the student's guardian

get.summary: Get a child by ID (parent only)

info.title: Halaqa Backend API
info.description: Authentication, user management, and school operations for the Halaqa system. All JSON responses are wrapped in a uniform envelope: `{ "code": <http>, "data": ... }` on success, `{ "code": <http>, "message": "..." }` on errors. Refresh tokens travel as HttpOnly cookies on `/auth/*`; access tokens use Bearer auth.

tags.name: Students
tags.description: Student CRUD, soft-delete/restore, and graduation. Visibility is role-scoped.

tags.name: Guardians
tags.description: Link, update, and unlink guardians for a student.

tags.name: My Children
tags.description: Parent-only views over their linked students.

roles.description: Role slugs to assign at creation (e.g. ["teacher", "parent"]).

details.description: Validation error list (only on 400 with multiple field errors).

message.example: A reset link has been sent.

rememberMe.description: When true, issues a long-lived refresh cookie (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS`). When false or absent, the cookie is short-lived (`JWT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS_DEFAULT`).

roles.description: Flat array of role slugs the user holds.

accessToken.description: JWT access token (HS256, 15 min). Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

roles.description: Flat list of role slugs. Authorization is role-based — there is no `permissions` field.

token.description: Raw token from the password-reset email link.

currentPassword.description: Current password — required to authorise the change.

current.description: True for the device that owns the cookie on the current request.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages (0–20).

id_number.description: National ID number. Always present when you can see the student. Value is null for legacy students created before this field was required.

is_primary.description: Exactly one guardian per student has this set.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages (0–20).

id_number.description: National ID number. Always present when you can see the student. Value is null for legacy students created before this field was required.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings. Present only when id_number validation produced warnings.

guardian_user_id.description: ID of an existing user. Mutually exclusive with `email`. Must belong to the same school.

email.description: Email of the guardian. Mutually exclusive with `guardian_user_id`. Creates a new user if not found.

name.description: Required when `email` is provided and the user does not yet exist.

is_primary.description: Exactly one guardian per student may be primary. If omitted on the first guardian, forced to true. Setting true unsets the current primary. Setting false on the current primary is rejected (400).

can_pickup.description: Whether the guardian is authorised to pick up the student. Defaults to true.

daily_hifz_pages_capacity.description: Daily Hifz memorisation target in pages. Defaults to 0.5.

daily_near_pages_capacity.description: Daily near-review target in pages. Defaults to 2.

daily_far_pages_capacity.description: Daily far-review target in pages. Defaults to 5.

id_number.description: National ID number. Format is country-specific (Palestinian: 9 digits). A bad checksum is stored with a warning, not rejected. Unique per school (soft-deleted rows included in the constraint).

guardians.description: Guardians linked atomically in the same transaction. First entry is forced to is_primary=true.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings. Present only when id_number validation produced warnings.

status.description: Use POST /students/:id/graduate to set graduated; this field accepts any status for admin overrides.

id_number.description: National ID number. Set to null to clear a previously-set value (requires force_id_number_change: true). Changing an already-set value also requires the flag. A bad checksum is stored with a warning in the response.

force_id_number_change.description: Required when changing or clearing an already-set id_number. Transient — never persisted.

graduation_date.description: Recorded in the audit log; does not update the student record directly.

is_primary.description: Set to true to promote this guardian to primary (unsets the current primary). Setting false is rejected with 400 — use another guardian's PATCH with is_primary=true instead.
